proposal.inferred_root_cause: gateway-layer fault reported as gateway_error while wallet:paytm itself is healthy
proposal.reasoning_trace: wallet:paytm is healthy on the rolling window at 92% success over 148 attempts against a 91% portfolio baseline, and no Razorpay downtime notice covers it. The issuer is answering normally, so a gateway-scoped code with no supporting telemetry is a thin claim: it is the most likely reading, not a confident one. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on wallet after 15m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear. This is the last attempt the stop rule permits, so it is spent after the window rather than inside it.
